name: Effective context engineering (Anthropic)
desc: Anthropic's formal definition: curating and maintaining the optimal set of tokens during LLM inference.

name: Context Engineering for Agents (LangChain)
desc: LangChain's canonical framing of the four moves: write, select, compress, isolate.

name: Context Engineering for Agents (Lance Martin)
desc: Widely-cited practitioner essay on managing an agent's context across its trajectory.

name: Context Engineering: A Practical Guide (Sourcegraph)
desc: Practical guide to context engineering for coding agents from the Sourcegraph/Amp team.

name: Context Engineering 101 (Victor Dibia)
desc: How agents implement context-engineering strategies, worked through Claude Code.

name: context-mode
desc: MCP server that sandboxes tool output (up to 98% token reduction) and persists session memory in SQLite with BM25 retrieval on compaction.

name: hermes-lcm
desc: DAG-based context engine that compacts old context into depth-aware summary nodes without dropping messages.

name: context-llemur
desc: Structural, human-plus-LLM-managed context tool for collaboration, no embeddings.

name: Context Compaction teardown (badlogic)
desc: Comparative teardown of how Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, and Amp handle context compaction.

name: LlamaIndex
desc: Leading data framework for ingesting, indexing, and retrieving context to augment LLM output.

name: Chroma
desc: Open-source vector database for building retrieval and context layers for LLM apps.

name: LLMLingua (Microsoft)
desc: Coarse-to-fine prompt compression using a small LM to drop low-information tokens; LLMLingua-2 and LongLLMLingua included.

name: LLMLingua paper
desc: Original paper on compressing prompts for accelerated inference while preserving quality.

name: Mem0
desc: Lightweight open-source memory layer adding persistent memory to any LLM app over vector and relational storage.

name: Letta (formerly MemGPT)
desc: Stateful-agent platform with main/recall/archival memory tiers the model pages in and out via tool calls.

name: Graphiti (Zep)
desc: Temporal knowledge-graph memory that tracks how facts change over time with provenance.

name: Cognee
desc: Open-source memory framework building knowledge graphs from data for agent long-term memory.

name: Screenpipe
desc: Searchable local screen text and audio history for agent context through MCP and a local API, source-available under the Screenpipe Commercial License.

name: tiktoken (OpenAI)
desc: OpenAI's official BPE tokenizer for exact local token counting to stay inside context windows and forecast cost.

name: tiktoken-cli
desc: CLI to count tokens across files and directories using tiktoken.

name: tiktoken-rs
desc: Rust tokenizer library for GPT/tiktoken token accounting.

name: ccusage
desc: CLI that parses Claude Code's local JSONL logs to report token usage and cost by day, session, and project.

name: claude-code-usage-analyzer
desc: Analyzes Claude Code usage data to profile token and context consumption.

name: DSPy (Stanford NLP)
desc: Framework for programming (not prompting) LLMs, with typed signatures, modules, and automated prompt/context optimization.

name: MCP Python SDK
desc: Official MCP SDK for exposing tools and resources that agents select into context.

name: FastMCP
desc: Ergonomic Python framework for building MCP servers that feed context to agents.

name: MetaGPT
desc: Multi-agent framework that isolates context across role-specialized agents.

name: CAMEL
desc: Framework for multi-agent systems with isolated per-agent contexts.

name: Ragas
desc: Reference-free RAG evaluation with metrics for context relevance and precision, plus synthetic test-set generation.

name: DeepEval
desc: Pytest-style LLM eval framework with debuggable RAG and context metrics for CI/CD.

name: Context Rot toolkit (Chroma)
desc: Toolkit reproducing Chroma's finding that LLM reliability degrades non-uniformly as input tokens grow, across 18 models.

name: Context Rot report (Chroma)
desc: Technical report showing performance drops with longer inputs, worse when needle and question are semantically similar.

name: NoLiMa (Adobe Research)
desc: Long-context benchmark beyond literal matching; needle and question share minimal lexical overlap, exposing steep degradation with length.

name: RULER (NVIDIA)
desc: Synthetic benchmark measuring the real usable context size across retrieval, multi-hop, aggregation, and QA.

name: NoLiMa paper
desc: ICML paper: even GPT-4o falls from 99.3% to 69.7% as context length grows on association-based retrieval.

name: LLMLingua-2 paper
desc: Task-agnostic prompt compression via token classification distilled from GPT-4, 3-6x faster.

name: The Complexity Trap
desc: Finds simple observation masking is as efficient as LLM summarization for agent context management.

name: ctxlens
desc: Context-window profiler for agents: shows what is eating your tokens and where to cut.

name: ctxtrim
desc: Trims AI-context bloat: finds the files ballooning your Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex token cost. npx ctxtrim.

name: tokencut
desc: Measure and cut the token cost of an LLM or agent message payload before you send it: truncate bloated tool results, drop duplicate context, trim to a budget. npx tokencut.
